title: ProjectileModel
description: Defines projectile behavior for ranged weapons.
content:
ProjectileModel

Defines projectile behavior for ranged weapons.

Model

Schema

JSON
{
  "speed": 15.0,
  "damage": 10,
  "lifetime": 3.0,
  "piercing": false,
  "gravity": 0.0
}

Description

The ProjectileModel defines the behavior of projectiles fired by ranged weapons in the Blastback Engine. It controls how fast the projectile travels, how much damage it deals on hit, how long it exists before being automatically destroyed, whether it can pierce through multiple targets, and how much gravity affects its trajectory. This model is referenced by weapon configurations to determine the characteristics of their fired projectiles.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
speedfloatThe movement speed of the projectile in units per second.
damageintThe amount of damage dealt to a target on hit.
lifetimefloatThe duration in seconds the projectile exists before being automatically destroyed.
piercingboolWhether the projectile passes through targets instead of being destroyed on first hit. Default is false.
gravityfloatThe downward gravitational force applied to the projectile. A value of 0.0 means the projectile travels in a straight line.

Example

JSON
{
  "speed": 8.0,
  "damage": 25,
  "lifetime": 5.0,
  "piercing": true,
  "gravity": 2.5
}

Related
